def get_numpy_ndarray_rows(obj, shape=None):
    if shape is None:
        shape = obj.shape
    
    # If the array is 1D, just yield the whole array
    if len(shape) == 1:
        yield ((), obj)
        return
    
    # For multi-dimensional arrays, iterate through all combinations of indices
    # except the last dimension
    preceding_dimensions = shape[:-1]
    
    # Generate all index combinations for dimensions except the last one

        # index_combo is a tuple of indices for all dimensions except the last

        yield (index_combo, row)

def get_numpy_ndarray_rows(obj, shape=None):
    if shape is None:
        shape = obj.shape
    
    # If the array is 1D, just yield the whole array
    if len(shape) == 1:
        yield ((), obj)
        return
    
    # For multi-dimensional arrays, iterate through all combinations of indices
    # except the last dimension
    preceding_dimensions = shape[:-1]
    
    # Generate all index combinations for dimensions except the last one
    for index_combo in cartesian_product_of_shape(preceding_dimensions):
        # index_combo is a tuple of indices for all dimensions except the last
        # Use it to index into the array to get the row (last dimension)
        row = obj[index_combo]
        yield (index_combo, row)
